title: CLO 2025 Course: Celebrate the National Day of the Motherland by creating National Day themed dresses with CLO.
description: The National Day themed dress live stream replay is here! Technical experts are online to teach you how to use the new 3D Pen (virtual model) feature in CLO 2025.1 to quickly sketch the structure of the dress. Experts will provide step-by-step explanations to help you master the new features and accelerate your workflow! Free materials can be obtained by visiting the CLO official WeChat account "CLO3D" and replying "National Day" in the backend.
